scope: Procedures for EXT-F-1004-T07 through T10, derived from current source and existing inventory. No UI, account, database, build, or runtime action performed.

source_basis.inventory: docs/stabilization/inventory.json: EXT-F-1004-T07..T10; shared control mappings C04 Phones and C05 Emails
source_basis.profile_surface: src/features/profile/ProfileView.tsx: ProfileView header, Phones and Emails Collapsible; PhonesEditor and EmailsEditor
source_basis.persistence: src/hooks/use-user-profile.ts: profile draft/save/load behavior; ProfileView Save and Discard controls
source_basis.runner_finding: Existing native acceptance orchestrates member/admin, warm and extension_reload dimensions, Profile open/back/save, owned-write journaling, and field/expander cases. It has no phone/email editor procedure or list serialization/restoration implementation. Its existing mutable field acceptance requires an owned-row journal before writes.

shared_run_protocol.identity: Use the existing account for the case mode only (member or admin); record account email, role evidence, device organization, build channel, extension ID/version/Loaded from path. Do not change role or account.
lifecycle: Run warm first without a just-completed extension reload; open Profile from the avatar dropdown.

For reload dimension, use chrome://extensions to reload the same extension, record completion, reopen the surface, recheck account/role/organization, and repeat the complete case independently. Panel reopen or page refresh is not extension reload.
shared_run_protocol.organization: Record the currently selected device organization for authenticated save. If the UI cannot establish the expected identity or organization, stop that execution as unverified; do not modify organization/account settings to force a pass.
shared_run_protocol.preflight_and_fixture: Before EACH role × lifecycle run, obtain an approved, owner-scoped, read-only exact JSON capture of the target persisted list and compare it with the expanded UI. A UI snapshot cannot see notes or distinguish absent, null, and false optional keys. Mutation is eligible only when that raw list is exactly [] and the UI shows its empty state, with an approved owner-scoped exact-list readback available after writes. Treat this as an empty owned fixture; only same-run synthetic entries may be removed. If the list contains any existing row, is unreadable, disagrees with the UI, or lacks an exact readback path, make no mutation and mark the product row unverified. A separately approved exact capture and restoration method would be required to test a nonempty list; this procedure supplies none. Never clear, delete, reorder, or change existing private rows to create a fixture.
shared_run_protocol.discard_and_back: Before the committed test, create one synthetic unsaved draft change, inspect it, click Discard, and assert the entire target draft list and raw persisted list still equal the empty baseline. Both header and bottom action bars contain Save and Discard; identify which instance was exercised. Click Back and assert the Chat surface is visible; reopen Profile, expand the target section, and confirm the empty list before starting the committed phase.
shared_run_protocol.save_and_reopen: After exercising controls, compare the COMPLETE ordered draft list with expected original [] plus the surviving synthetic entry, including all exposed values and flags. Click a named header or bottom Save and wait for saving to settle. While still in Profile, require no visible profile.error/save error and compare the complete displayed list, then obtain an independent approved owner-scoped raw readback of the entire persisted list. A disabled Save button alone proves nothing. Click Back and assert Chat is visible; reopen Profile and compare the complete list again. For reload dimension, additionally reload the extension, recheck identity/organization, reopen Profile, and compare the complete list and raw readback again. A rejected save or reproducible wrong list is fail; an unreadable/ambiguous write is unverified.
shared_run_protocol.cleanup: Only for an eligible empty owned fixture, remove the surviving same-run synthetic entry through the UI, Save, require no visible save error, and verify both full UI list and approved owner-scoped raw readback equal exact []. Reopen Profile and repeat the UI comparison; repeat after extension reload for reload rows. Never use a blanket clear, direct API/DB delete, or delete any pre-existing row. If a write is ambiguous, stop further mutation until an approved owner-scoped read-only reconciliation establishes exactly what was written; report cleanup_result unverified until empty restoration is proven. If cleanup is attempted and demonstrably fails, report cleanup_result failed. Do not claim cleanup from the UI alone.
shared_run_protocol.failure_semantics: Record product_result pass/fail/unverified and cleanup_result restored/failed/unverified separately for every role × lifecycle row. Reproducibly missing control, save error/rejection, failed Discard or Back assertion, or verified draft/persistence mismatch is product fail, even if cleanup later succeeds. Missing identity/organization, unavailable exact-state capture/readback, uncertain write, or an unexecuted dimension is unverified, never pass. Preserve any product failure alongside cleanup failure. Overall acceptance requires all eight product rows pass and all eight cleanup results restored; any failed row fails acceptance, otherwise any unverified row leaves acceptance unverified. Record safe phase/control identifiers and sanitized error category, never credentials or raw sensitive values.

execution_prerequisites: Existing member and admin identities on the intended device, verified organization, and same extension build for warm/reload; no account or organization changes to manufacture eligibility.
Approved owner-scoped read-only capture/readback of the exact persisted phones or emails JSON list, including hidden notes and optional-key presence; no raw sensitive values in the report.
For each independent role/lifecycle run, persisted list exactly [] and UI empty state; nonempty private lists remain untouched until a separately approved exact restoration method exists.
